name: Princess Play
source:
Main character is the third prince of a small country Ipushia sandwiched between superpowers. One day a veiled woman comes and requests to train a certain girl as a slave. The reward is independence of Ipushia. There's no guarantee in woman's words, but the reward is well worth the task if the woman speaks truth. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是夾在超級大國之間的小國伊普西亞的三王子。有一天，一位蒙著面紗的女人來了，要求將某個女孩訓練為奴隸。回報是伊普西亞的獨立。女人的話沒有任何保證，但如果她所言屬實，這份報酬倒值得他一試。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
